items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: How did James go home, let you say?

ctx.x: They didn't have any music on anything at school, I guess. Music? No.

They used to have a St. Al's Press. They used to have a great job, and they would give grace, and have a whole lunch. And then, what he said, back of your books. He used to have a good deal. And if I lived in the same neighborhood here again, he would send you home probably an hour, half hour in a time, and start telling him I had to serve. Then he let me cook, as an hour we wouldn't be together. And he'd come and say, what? How did James go home, let you say? No sir. What happened? I'm punishing you? What you're…
Why didn't you learn anything at the pocket store?
